exposure: Feeding mode (exclusive breastfeeding, formula feeding, mixed feeding)
outcome: Overall microbial composition at the genus level
cohort: This study included 75 six-week-old infants from the STRONG Kids2 cohort, categorized by feeding mode (exclusive breastfed, formula-fed, or mixed-fed) and delivery mode (vaginal or Cesarean section).
finding: Fecal microbiota composition and function, along with metabolite profiles, of 6-week-old mixed-fed infants were found to be more similar to formula-fed infants than breastfed infants.
mod_finding: Delivery mode influenced overall microbial composition and 24 functional pathways (16 higher in vaginally delivered infants), and 47 differential metabolites (39 lower in Cesarean section infants).
cross-section timing: Samples were collected when infants were 6-weeks-old.
